text: Strava crowns the fastest. We celebrate everyone else.
Every ride earns its own awards: best of the year, season firsts.
Tap a ride to replay it in 3D, colored by power.
Fifty kinds of awards, each one measured against your own history.
Power curves that know just how tired you already were.
And every ride you've ever done, together on one map.
No ads, no tracking. Just you and your Strava data, on your device, in your browser.
And it's all free. AY-yoo dot I-O.
